name: Nekros
description: There is a reaper whose name is Nekros. He provides deathly crowd control. Erstwhile enemies become allies when Nekros calls up recruits from the dead.
passiveDescription: Restore |HEALTH| Health with every enemy death within |RADIUS|m.

abilities.description: A blow so powerful, it turns the enemy's very soul into a deadly projectile, damaging all in its path. Enemies that survive the blow are Marked for Harvest and become one of Nekros' Shadows of the Dead if killed while marked.
Cast fear into the hearts of nearby enemies, causing them to run away in terror.
Forces fallen enemies around you to drop additional loot.
Summon shadow versions of vanquished enemies to fight alongside you for a short period.
